headline: Last session: Markets snapped two-week gains as rising crude oil prices and FII selling weighed on sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 26 October.

why: Surging Brent crude oil prices toward six-month highs created significant macro drag.
Foreign Institutional Investors (FII) selling weighed heavily on D-Street sentiment.
Rising commodity bills put pressure on commercial vehicle margins.
Regulatory scrutinies and FDA inspection observations affected specific pharmaceutical counters.
whatHappening: In the last trading session, Nifty ended at 22,600 as key indices snapped a two-week winning streak.
Coforge raised its FY27 margin guidance as AI driven changes improved its cost equation.
U.S. FDA issued four observations following an inspection at Gland Pharma's facility near Hyderabad.
Kilitch Drugs agreed to divest its Ethiopian subsidiary for $14 million.
summary: On the last trading session, Indian equities snapped a two-week rally with Nifty closing at 22,600 amid elevated crude oil prices and FII selling. Stock-specific action remained prominent with Coforge raising margin guidance and Gland Pharma receiving FDA observations. Markets remain closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, 26 October.
